title: AI University: seven paths and working learning labs
summary: Add 21 complete authored lessons, interactive demonstrations, performance-based progress, placement, spaced recall, portfolio CRUD and a document Q&A project.

changes.detail: Seven structured paths with objectives, prerequisites, beginner and technical explanations, diagrams/demos, real examples, exercises, two quizzes with choice-specific feedback, review and primary-source references per lesson. Titles/summaries and main navigation support English/French/Arabic; detailed technical content is English with an explicit notice.

Five learning modes including the existing AI Tutor handoff; Python Studio and Agent Studio links. Checked exercises, placement recommendations, delayed-recall evidence and persistent editable/deletable project artifacts reuse School storage.

Document Q&A provides real local lexical retrieval and an optional authenticated, rate-limited, size-bounded server model request with explicit content-sharing consent. No live provider request or deployment has been performed.
Home destinations and My learning link to AI University while preserving existing navigation and progress.

validation.name: Implementation verification
validation.detail: Typecheck, content integrity, behavioral tests, backend mocks and browser layout/flows pending.
